# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by "Activities" in top-left corner)
- **Application Title Bar**: "anonym-x2024@outlook.com - Mozilla Thunderbird"
- **System Time**: "Oct 23 17:29" displayed in the top-center of the screen
- **System Tray Icons**: Located in the top-right corner, including:
  - Network/Connection indicator
  - Sound/volume control
  - Power button

## Application Window

- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird"
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in the top-right corner
- **Window Border**: Light gray border with subtle shadowing

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help
- **Toolbar Buttons** (below menu bar):
  - Send
  - Encrypt
  - Spelling (with dropdown)
  - Save (with dropdown)
  - Contacts

## Email Composition Area

### From Field

- **Label**: "From"
- **Content**: "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>"
- **Dropdown**: "anonym-x2024@outlook.com" with a dropdown arrow

### To Field

- **Label**: "To"
- **Content**: "target@target.com" (text is highlighted)
- **Additional Controls**: Cc, Bcc buttons to the right

### Subject Field

- **Label**: "Subject"
- **Content**: Empty text field

### Formatting Toolbar

- **Paragraph Dropdown**: "Paragraph" with dropdown arrow
- **Variable Width Dropdown**: "Variable Width" with dropdown arrow
- **Text Formatting Icons**:
  - Text color (black square)
  - Font size (T with up/down arrows)
  - Bold (B)
  - Italic (I)
  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough (S)
  - Font color (A)
  - Alignment (left, center, right)
  - List (bulleted, numbered)
  - Indentation (increase/decrease)
  - More options (dropdown arrow)

### Message Body

- **Content**: Blank white area for composing the email
- **Cursor**: Text cursor (I-beam) positioned at the start of the message body

## Sidebar

- **Application Icons** (left sidebar):
  - Thunderbird Mail (envelope icon)
  - Calendar (calendar icon)
  - Tasks (checkmark icon)
  - Chat (speech bubble icon)
  - Other application icons (Firefox, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Ubuntu Software, Help, Trash)

## Main Window Content

- **Search Bar**: "Search... CTRL + K" with a magnifying glass icon
- **Account Settings**: "Account Settings" with a gear icon in the top-right
- **Feature Buttons**:
  - "Message filters"
  - "End-to-end Encryption"
  - "Filelink"
  - "Feeds"
  - "Newsgroups"
- **Donation Message**: "Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please consider making a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to make a donation."
- **Thunderbird Logo**: A faint outline of a bird (Thunderbird logo) in the bottom-right corner

## Status Bar

- **Status Indicator**: "(o) Done" at the bottom-left corner
